name: Queensland Gold Hills Corp.
summary: Queensland Gold Hills Corp. primarily engages in the procurement, exploration, and subsequent development of mineral properties. The company's portfolio includes the Big Hill gold project, located in Queensland, Australia, which holds an exploration permit and two associated mining licenses. Additionally, it possesses interests in the Titan gold project, an expansive 90-square-kilometer site also situated in Queensland, Australia. This entity was previously recognized as Minfocus Exploration Corp. Queensland Gold Hills Corp. operates its main office from Vancouver, Canada.
